MeasurementToolMetadata.Description: Part 3: Familiarity with Video Games. Nine-item self-report Likert subscale (1=Strongly Disagree .. 7=Strongly Agree), administered pre-experiment. From the Duorhythm questionnaire.

item_02.Description: I feel confident in my ability to learn new video games quickly.

item_03.Description: I am familiar with the controls and mechanics of most video games.

item_04.Description: I can quickly learn and adapt to new control schemes when playing video games.

item_05.Description: I often play video games that require coordination with another player.

item_06.Description: I have experience playing video games that involve controlling a moving object or character.

item_07.Description: I am comfortable with playing video games that require quick reactions and decision-making.

item_08.Description: I am used to playing video games that involve strategy and planning.

item_09.Description: I am used to playing video games that involve teamwork or cooperation with another player.
